tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of LT cables
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office YTPS Raichur

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer for all the terms and condition and document for your reference

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall furnish PO copies of 1.1kV or above rated underground cable of value not less the 42.78 Lakhs. In proof of the same bidder should submit (up load) copies of purchase order for having supplied the above material to any major power PSU/central/State Generating/Distributing company/major industry issued by competent authority. In case of authorized dealers, PO copies submitted should be in their name not on their principals.

The bidder shall be a Manufacturer/Authorized Dealers of Havells, KEI, Finolex, V- guard only for power cables. Authorization letter from manufacturing company shall be furnished in case supplied by authorized dealers.

The Bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs. 85.56 Lakhs in at least two financial years, of the preceding five financial years i.e, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. As a proof of this, the bidder shall furnish Annual turnover certificate, Balance sheet and profit & loss statement duly certified by Chartered Accountant.
